evidence_class: SCENARIO ONLY: engine-correctness and test-behaviour evidence, never a performance result

model_candles.about: a gap is not filled at the stop price
model_candles.name: GAP_THROUGH_STOP

model_candles.about: a touch fills at the stop
model_candles.name: EXACT_TOUCH_STOP

model_candles.about: a touch fills at the target
model_candles.name: EXACT_TOUCH_TARGET

model_candles.about: opened above then traded through the stop
model_candles.name: OPEN_BEYOND_STOP

model_candles.about: expiry closes at the bar's own close
model_candles.name: EXPIRY_AT_CLOSE

model_candles.about: the short side mirrors the rules
model_candles.name: SHORT_SIDE_MIRROR

model_candles.about: a bar that touches both legs is not decidable from candle data
model_candles.declared_rule: when a single bar touches both the stop and the target, the STOP is taken first: the conservative, deterministic reading of an unknowable intrabar order
model_candles.name: SNU_BOTH_TOUCHED

model_candles.about: the same bars exit by expiry when the decision is unprotected and stop out at the entry reference when the policy name declares a bracket - the divergence the reconciliation reports as BRACKET_CONTRACT_DIVERGENCE
model_candles.name: BRACKETLESS_NO_STOP_OUT

overfitting_hypothesis_test.about: the test must reject a family selected on noise (>= 0.5) and must not reject a genuine drift edge (<= 0.25); a test that rejects nothing proves nothing

snu.declared_rule: when a single bar touches both the stop and the target, the STOP is taken first: the conservative, deterministic reading of an unknowable intrabar order
